name: FUN_DOCIO_AL_EVENTS
description: This table contains metadata associated with Adaptive Learning events, providing a comprehensive record of each activity to support tracking, analysis, and management of these events.

columns.name: TRAIN_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Training event identifier for Adaptive Learning.

columns.name: ARTIFACT_ID
columns.description: Output training artifact ID from the Adaptive Learning event.

columns.name: LEARNING_DATE
columns.description: The date when the learning data was received.

columns.name: MSG_ENVELOPE_ID
columns.description: The source message identifier that was used by the Adaptive Learning (AL) Training Processor.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: The predicted language of the document.

columns.name: LEARNING_DATA
columns.description: Training data collected for the adaptive learning event.

columns.name: AL_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Indentifies the corresponding transformation mapping for Adaptive Learning.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
